package.name: Built-In Preference Packs
package.description: Preference Packs included with the FreeCAD distribution

preferencepack.name: FreeCAD Classic
preferencepack.description: Removes stylesheets, and applies the classic purple/gray background. Resets all colors to default

preferencepack.name: FreeCAD Native
preferencepack.description: FreeCAD-native presentation stack used by Compatibility Profiles (CAD navigation, FreeCAD Light theme defaults).

preferencepack.name: Creo Inspired
preferencepack.description: Creo-inspired presentation stack: theme tokens, Creo-inspired navigation, curated shortcuts, and main-window layout. Not affiliated with PTC.

preferencepack.name: SolidWorks Inspired
preferencepack.description: SolidWorks-inspired presentation stack: theme tokens, SolidWorks navigation style, curated shortcuts, and main-window layout. Not affiliated with Dassault Systemes.
